question.problem: Estimate the area under the curve $y=3x-{x}^{2}$ over the interval $[0.5,2.5]$ using a left Riemann sum with step size $Δx=0.5.$
question.worked_solution:
Let's sketch our situation.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14221930/assets/0e3f499cbc36c9dca7e759b67a8fd9e94959039f3403832e1d60b9ed598c44dd.png)

The area $A$ can be approximated using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈(\overset{\text{heights}}{\overset{⏞}{f({x}_{0})+f({x}_{1})+…+f({x}_{n-1})}})\cdot \,\,{{Δx}_{⏟}}_{\text{ }\text{width}} \\  & =(f(0.5)+f(1)+f(1.5)+f(2))\cdot Δx.\end{aligned}
$$

So, we now set up a table with the values of $f(x)$ at each point:

| $x$ | $0.5$ | $1$ | $1.5$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $1.25$ | $2$ | $2.25$ | $2$ |

Finally, we obtain the following approximation for our area:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈(1.25+2+2.25+2)\cdot 0.5 \\  & =7.5\cdot 0.5 \\  & =3.75\end{aligned}
$$
